tei:div.tei:p: bhe dzi —༷trī 4rtetsā — rī— rwatresdu —snye cho d+ngha— ṣe—ོ theci 4 zhe — sdu 1 ri ci ne / sgyu ko lha/pya tshochi 4 ༷4 /

dkar chagadang po/ dpal shādī kāsdi/ cho sa sde 'i lo sa ra ga sa (1)gcig shāṭ+wāṃ ( ṭāṭ+wāṃ zlo /ba'i lung bstan ji ltar byu nga tshu la / /khro/gnyis/ chos sde phyag 'debs pa'i rgyu rkyen/ (3)gsum/ chos sde 'debs pa'i dus/ (3)bzhi/ chos sde 'debs pa'i dgos pa/ (4)lnga/ chos sde 'phel rgyas 'byung tshul gyi lung bstan/ (4)drug gabye/ /sdus dang po gtum stonablo gros grags tsho kyibadun/ rtebyen༄ drob/sa bzhi pa gro ston ba du da rtsi gra ga sa ri57brgyad/ rdo// dṛb/sa drug pa sangs rgyas sgom pa se nga ge (5)skyabs kyi sku dus/ (7)dgu/ gdan rabasabadun pa mchims nam mkha' grags kyi sku dus/ (10)bcu/ gdan rabs baspyad palha stonatsān lam tshul 1

khrims ༷/ sku rnga1sa/ (13)bcu gcig gdan rabs bcu gsum pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sku dus/ (15)bcu gnyis/ snar thang gi nang rten skor/ (17)bcu gsum/ chos sde'i grwa tshang gi skor/ (18)bcu bzhi/ chos lugs kyi byed sgo'i skor/ (20)bco lnga/ chos sde'itre 'dus sde rim bzhin 'phel bcu drug trīdī shātrī nār+sha/sa ka da nga 'a tsho ba 'i yo nga (22)bcu bdun/khudīpasdiṭ+wāṃ/ tshi ga /khroṭ+wāṃ/gnyis pa/ dadīlado spyar— trīX gi gdanarabasanya shu'iram thar tsho nogacig rna wa~Xtwe /stowa/ blo gros gra ga sa kyi rna ma tha ra 526tshomador bsdus/ (26)gnyis/ sdo /sdo shes rab grags kyi rnam thar mdor gsum/ shāX dī/tsun rdo rje 'od zer gyi rnam tha ra ma do ra (27)༵zhi/ bzlo rdzun/ bdud rtsi grags kyi rna ma tha ra ma do ra (27)

bsdus/ (28)lnga/ mnga' bdag chos rje chos kyi bla ma'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ (29)drug sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus/ (30)bdun/ patrīsdas nam mkha' grags kyi rnam thar mdor tsho kyibargyad/ bye ṅgeṅge/ smon lam tshul khrims kyi rnam tha ra ma do ra ri317dgu makārdos che/na nyi ma rgyal ma tsha na gyi rna ma tha ra (33)mdor bsdus/ (34)bcu/ ༷staX 1snyin grags pa brtson 'grus kyi rnam thar tsho rkobacu gcipre—tweprebye ṭ+wāṃn/ grags pa shes rab kyi rna ma tha ra riyotshomador bsdus/ (35)bcu gnyikā/sduṭ+wāṃ/chims blo bzang grags kyi rnam tha ra ma do ra (mo)bcu gsum/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus/ (37)bcu bzhi/ mkhan chen thub pa shes rab kyi rnam thar mdor 3

bcu lnga/ dīṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ/ nams mchog spub grags ba za nga pa 'i rna ma (38)thar mdor bsdus/ (39)bcu drug —sdujin chen grags don pa'i rnam thar mdor ‘ kyibacu bdubye/༄ṭ+wāṃ/khan chen bzod pa dpal grub kyi rna ma thar ri41tshomador bsdus/ (41)bcu brgyad/ 'dul 'dzin dpal ldan bzang po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ (42)bcu dgu/ mkhan chen shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus/ (43)nyi shu/ mkhan chen grags pa shes rab (phyi ma )kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus/ (44)gsum pa/ bka' bstan par sbyan gyi byung ba/ (46)gcig ༷ljoga' 'gyur rin po che par bsko ji ltar byas gnyis/ byerte /kābang por phyi nang gi ma thu na rkye na 'a dzo ma sa (46)gsum/ ṭītrī bye ṭ+wāṃ/gal rkyen khyad du ba sad na sa snyi nga (46) 4 stobs 'dzugs pa'i skor/ (48)

bzhi/ par brko'i bkod 'doms dang dngos po'i sta gon byas pa'i skor/ (49)lnga/ dngos gzhi'i las grwa 'go 'dzugs pa'i dus dang gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i skor/ (50)drug bzo bo las byed mi sna'i skor/ (50)bdun/ ṅgidṛ/ byed rnams kyi lha ga ba sa ma ra nga 'a gu la (51)brgyad/ bzo bo rnams la ston mo 'gyed pa'i skor/ (52)dgu/ dīzo —sdi kāXs kyi lag rjes kyi tshad gzhi mi bcu/ laṭ+wāṃ /ṭ+wāṃ ༵ṅge dī/da ji tsam 'a go ra ba 'i skor/ /shārdo/bcu gcig 'gro song gi skor/ (53)bcu gnyis/ bzo bo rnams kyi lag yon skor/ (54)bcu gsum/ mgyogs tshad dang spus tshad la gzhigs pa'i bya dga'i skor/ (55)bcu ba'i/ bka' 'gyur gyi gsung par rnams snar thang chos sder ji ltar phebs tshul/ (56)bco lnga/ mi'i dbang pos bstan 'gyur par skun mdzad shādri /mthun rkyen dang snying stob sa 'a dzu ga sa pa 'i shā57)

bcu drug par shing rnams kyi yong khungs skor/ (57)bcu bdun/ 'gro song gi skor/ (58)bco brgyad/ 'go pa dang las byed mi sna'i skor/ (58)bco dgu/ par brko dbu tshugs pa'i dus dang las yun ji tsam 'gor ba'i skor/ (59)nyi shu/ thub pa'i mdzad brgya'i thang par dang tsong kha ༵ṭ+wāṃkā shā'i/ thang par so ga sa par sgru na ma dza da (yo)nyer gcig par shing de dag snar thang chos sder ji ltar phebs tshul skor/ (60)6

gling gzhi/༵ spra ṭāsnatrī / sbyasna kā ṭ+wāṃ dī sbya / sbya~X py-im// //nyi shu'i gdan rabs bstar la brgyus pa'i phreng / /rim byon blo chen de rnams bkur ba'i yul/ /dpal snar thang gi chos sde chen po 'di nyid ni/ bod ljongs gzhis rtse rdzong chu mig chus khongs su gnas pa'i mnyam med jo bo bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa grags can zhig yin/ 'di ni bshes gnyen ston pa rin po che nas brgyud pa'i bka' gdams kyi rnam thar dri ma med pa'i brtul zhugs lhur bzhes pa'i skyes chen dam pa mang pos zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen zhig dang / skye rgya'i bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs pa'i mchog gsum dam pa'i rten byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba du ma dang / bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi lag rtsal gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i bzo brkos ri mo'i rnam grangs mang po dang /gzhan yang rgyal khab phyi nang gi lag rtsal gyi rnam pa mtshon pa'i rig rdzas dngos po'i rjes shul du mas phyug cing lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i dgon sde chen po zhig yin pas chos sde 'di'i sngon byung gi lo rgyus rags tsam zhig 'dir bsgrigs par/ 1

dang po/ dpal snar thang chosasde'i lo rgyusaragasatsamabashad pa/gcig chos sde 'byung ba'i lung bstana' ltar byung tshul/rab byung dang po'i chu rta (1༷42)lor jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha mnga' ris nas dbus gtsang du phebs pa'i lam bar snar thang gi sa'i 'dabs gzhogs la'i rtser nye gnas la glang po che'i sna 'dra ba'i ri pha gi'i 'jag thang steng du gang 'dug ltos shig gsungs par/ nye gnas kyis 'jag thang gi brag rdog thog spru gser sbrang bcu drug 'dug ces zhus/jo bo rjes khyod rang las snang ma dag pas ma mthong ba ma gtogs der gnas brtan bcu drug gso spyong mdzad kyin yod/ ma 'ongs pa na gnas der dgon sde chen po zhig kyang 'byung ngo zhes lung bstan cing /phyis snar thang zhes pa'i tha snyad de yang de la brten par mngon no/bka' gdams glegs bam las kyang / shar ba ji bzhin rtswa chu dang / /shing dang grong pa dag gis dbe+en/ / skya bo rgya chen zhag med cing / /snum zhing skal bzang du ma 'du/ / zhes gtum ston blo gros grags kyis sha ra ba'i zhal chems bzhin du gong gsal khyad chos de dag ldan pa'i gnas der dgon pa 'byung ba dang / dgon pa 'debs pa po dang der 'du ba'i bcud kyi gang zag dang bcas pa gsal bar lung bstan to/ /2

gnyis/ chos sde phyag 'debs pa'ir+gharkyen/bka'agadams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po sha ra ba sku mya ngan las 'da' khar gtum ston la gtsang pa 'dul 'dzin pa zhes 'bod par mdzad nas gdams ngag gi 'phro cung zad gnang ste lhag ma skye ba phyi ma la byed pa yin no/ khyod kyis dge slong bzhi sde re dang 'grogs shig ces sha ra ba'i zhal chems su gnang ba ji lta ba bzhin du dgon rnga/ 'debs rgyur thugs thag bcad do/ /gsum/ chos sde 'debs pa'i dus/bdag cag gi ston pa bugs rje can sku mya ngan las 'das tshul bstan nas lo 19ṭ+wāṃ4(bu ston lugs gzhir byas )dang / rab byung gsum pa'i chu bya (1152)lo/ rwa sgrong dgon pa btab nas lo 96pa/gtum ston rang nyid dgung lo 48bzhes pa'i tshe/ snar thang gi thang stod la lo ra zhig yod pa'i gnas der/ spyil bu brtsigs te 'an bu 'dir dge sbyor byed pa yin gsungs nas dge slong bzhi sde dang bcas phyag phebs so/ snar thang dgon pa btab pa'i thog ma 'di nas bzung rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu phag (19rdo2)lo/ rab lo 957pa bar la lo ṭ+wāṃ29song nas 82༷pa'i steng na yod/ / 3

bzhi/ chos sde 'debs pa'i dgos pa/rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par bka' gdams glegs bam las ji ltar lung bstan pa ltar jo bo bka' gdams pa'i tshang la ma nor ba'i bstan khro rin po che de nyid gtsang phyogs sogs su rgyas par bya ba'i ched du yin no/ /lnga/ chos sde 'phelasgyus 'byung tshul gyi lung bstan/glegs bam las/ mdor na gnas mchog de dag tu/ / dang po bzhi grwa nas bzung ste/ /tha mar stong phrag phyed dang gsum/ /bslab pa gsum ldan shākya'i sras/ /'gro ba kun gyi mgon du gyur/ /gnas der phyogs dang phyogs mtshams nas/ / 'du ldan dpag med 'du bar 'gyur/ /phyir yang las can phyogs bcur 'phros/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho dag dang mtshungs/ /chu bo brgya yis gang mi nus/ /de tsam zhig gis dma' mi nus/ /zhes dang / bla rabs 'byon tshul yang / da ni bshes gnyen dam pa mchog /gsum gsum dam pa mchog tu 'byung / /zhes gsum tshan gsum phyir 'byung bar bstan/ bye brag tu bstan pa ni/ blo gros mtshan ldan mtshungs pa med/ /ces sogs byung ba bla rabs so so'i rnam tha/ bshad pa'i skabs dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /

drug gdanarabs dang po gtum ston blo gros gragasat+pa sku dus/gong du brjod zin pa ltar gtum ston blo gros grags rang nyid kyi bzhugasaganas su spyil bu chung ngu zhig brtsigs pa dang / dge slong bzhi sde re 'dus nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi sgo nas bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad tshul dang gsham du rang nyid kyi rnam thar nang brjod rgyu'i byung ba de dag tsam las phyag rjes gzhan gyi lo rgyus yig cha kha gsal zhig ma rnyed la de bzhin gdan rabs gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i sku dus kyi chos sde'i gnas tshul yang skabs 'dir ma rnyed do/ /bdun/ gdanarabs bgi pa gro ston bdud rtsi gragasakli sku dus/ gdan rabs 'di'i sku dus su thub dbang gsum sbags ma zhes pa'i rten grags can de byung / rten de'i lo rgyus ni gro ston bdud rtsi grags dang gnas brtan bcu drug gsol ba lhan cig tu bzhes skabs phud mchod las grub cing rten des gsungs par ma 'ongs pa na las ngan pa'i sems can gyis nga zas yong ba dang / 'brel yod rnams tshogs gsog pa'i ched du phyi la gser zangs sgron gsungs pa dang / de zispya pa

dang yang ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams kyis nga tshong 'gyur byed yong bas phyi la 'jim pas 'al bar byon gsungs pa ltar 'jim pa bsgron pas thub dbang gsum sbags ma zhes pa'i tha snyad chags so/ 'jang ka nub ma'i steng gi thub dbang gsum sbags ma'i lha khang de dus phyis bzhengs par mngon zhing / rgya khyon ka ba bzhi/ rten gyi gtso bo thub dbang gsum sbags ma dang / g.yas g.yon du sman 'jim las grub pa'i jo 'brom yab sras mi tshad ma dang / sbyan ras gzigs so gas li sku mang du bzhugs shing / da dung rje dge 'dun spub pas phyag mdzub kyis 'bri gnang mdzad pa'i ma ṇi'i gzugs dbyibs dod pa'i rdo nag gcig kyang bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon du bka' 'gyur gser chos cha tshang bzhugs/khang steng du thugs bzhi/ gser zangs kyi gardzi ra gcig bcas yod/'jang ka dkyil ma'i steng gi khams gsum lha khang (dus phyis rgyal po mi dbang gi gzim chung du byas par grags )ni rgya khyon ka ba drug rten gyi gtso bor mchims lha rje go cha'i thugs dam gyi rten li ma las thub pa'i rgyal ba mi 'khrusas mgon po'i sku brnyan mi tshad lhag tsam dang / g.yas g.yon du spyan ras gzigs kha sa ra pa ṇi dang / byams mgon mi tshad ma bzhengs sku gnyis sogs li sku mang po dang / bstan 'gyur skya chos par ma cha tshang yang bzhugs/ khang steng du thug bzhi dang gser zangs kyi gardzi ra gcig yod/ par khang chen mo'i nang gi mgon khang ni rgya khyon ka bganyis/ nang rten du sman 'jim las grub pa'i dgon po gur (snar thadī gi dpal mgon zhes pa'i rten grags can zhig )dang / cha kadzā ti/

dud gsol ma bcas thog tshad can gyi gtso 'khor gsum bzhugs shing phyag mtshan bskang rdzas bcas pa yang bshams yod/brgyad/ gdan rabs drug pa sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs kyisku dus/mkhas pa chen po bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri yang skabs der snar thang gi chos sder phebs/ rnam thar mdor bsdus ni 'di ltar/ khong ni lhokha yul phu dang gi ban btsun yin la chung ngu'i dus nas bsam yas mchod rten dkar po'i btsun pa mdzad/ de nas skyid shod dga' ba gdong du dbyar gyi dus nyi ma brtson 'grus la phar phyin slob bzhin yod pa'i tshe sa nad kyi thugs rtog cig byung bas snar thang du skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims kyi sar khams bcos su phebs/ skabs der snar thang gi rgyal sgo'i them par zhabs bzhag pa dang dus mtshungs/ dbu la nyi ma shar ba dang tshogs dung 'bud pa rnams dus gcig la khel bas rten 'brel bzang bar dgongs/ 'dis sangs rgyas sgom pa ba dang mchims nam mkha' grags gnyis ka'i zhabs la gtug cing / skyo ston pa la khams bcos su zhus pa na/ skyo ston pa'i bka' ltar snar thang gi grog khug cig tu tshad ma rnam nges kyi gzhung tshar stong bshar bas khong gi mdze nad kyang sangs/ de nas snar thang gi chos grwar sbyang pa mdzad pas rig gnas mtha' dag la thogs pa med pa'i mkhas par rgyur/ mi g.yo shā'i

bsnyen pa dung phyur bcu gsum bskyal bas shes rab kyi nam langs/chos skyong zhal bzhi pas kyang zhabs tog bsgrubs/ 'chad nyan mdzad pas slob ma shin tu mkhas pa mang po byung / dus skabs der sde snod 'dzin pa'i gsum gnyis tsam snar thang du 'dus zhes kyang grags so/btsun pa 'jam dbyangs pak+ṇi yang khong gi slob ma yin/ nyin gcig chos kyi bar seng la btsun pa 'jam dbyangs kyis 'dre brdzu byas nas bcom ldan pa la sdig bskur bas bcom ldan pa shin tu 'jigs nas thugs mi bde ba byung ba na/ btsun pas bdag yin pas thugs mi bde ba ge 'tshal zhes zhus kyang shin tu bka' bkyon te de nas bzung bsdom ldan pa'i drung du 'dug dbang ma byung bar sa skyar byon nas der bzhugs skabs yon rgyal rabs kyi gong mas sgru yan du rgyal po'i mchod gnas la gdan drangs/ pho brang shang dor bzhugs skabs tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi ṭik+ka bsdus pa zhig kyang brtsams/ khong rgya nag tu bzhugs ring gser yig pa brgyud nas bcom ldan pa thugs mnyes thabs su 'bul ba gang mang phul yang thugs zin pa ma byung zhing mthar snag tsha dang / gu/pag gri sgam chung gang sogs yo byad kyi cha rkyen tshan chen po bskur bas bcom ldan pa shin tu mnyes nas 'di la shes rab yod gsungs nas thugs khrel sangs/ spyir bcom ldan pas brtsams pa'i bstan bcos po ti bcu drug tsam yod cing / lhag par bcom ldan pas bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' rnams kyi grangs dang / bam tshad 'gyur byang sogs ngekā nges mdzad cing / bstan bcos rnams kyang so sor phye khres tshan

tshan du bsdu ba'i bstan pa rgyas par bya ba zhes pa'i bstan bcos shigakyang mgyid/ mchims nam mkha' grags kyis kyang la stod 'ol rgod kyi gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i phran tshegs sgo brgyad ka tshang ba'i 'dul ba lung sde bzhi tshang zhing dag pa yang snar thang gtsug lag khang du bzhag par mdzad pa sogs kyi cha rkyen legs par bskun pa dang / rgya nag nas btsun pa 'jam dbyangs pak+ṇis dbus pa blo gsal sogs la bka' dang bstan bcos bod du bsgrur ro cog bzhengs la/ dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs par gyis shig ces lan bskur bas kyang rkyen byas dbus pa blo gsal ba byang chub ye shes dang / lo dz+dza ba bsod nams 'od zer/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum gsum gyis 'bad pa chen pos bka' bstan gnyis kyi phyi mo gang yod bsdus te bcom ldan pa dang mnyam du legs par bzhengs nas 'jam dbyangs lha khang du bzhugs par mdzad do/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir bka' bstan gyi ma phyi thog ma ni bcom ldan rig ral gyis bsdus pa'i snar thang gi bka' bstan 'di kho na yin pas de las mched de stod du sa skya dang gung thang / smad du tshal gung thang stag lung sogs dang / mkhas pa chen po bu ston rin chen spub kyis kyang snar thang gi bstan 'gyur spyan drangs te zlos pa rnams dor/ go rim med pa rnams kyi go rim legs par bsgrigs/ chos kyi rnam grangs gsar pa stong lhag tsam bsnan nas zha lu'i gtsug lag khang du bzhugs par mdzad/ de la ma phyi byas nas rtse thang dang / gong dkar/ gdan sa mthil/ khams dbus/ mtshur phu sogs su bgrang las 'da~X pa

zhig byung ba de dag gi rtsa ba mthar gtugs na/ bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri dang de'i slob ma btsun pa 'jam dbyangs pak+ṇi gnyis kyi bka' drin nyag gcig las byung bas shes par byos shig /dgu/ gdan rabs bdun pa mchimasanam mkha' grags kyi sku dus/gdan rabs 'di'i sku dus su sum stong sdings 'es pa'i gtsug lag khang de byung bar mngon zhing / de'i gtsang khang rgya khyon ka ba drugarten gtsor li ma las grub pa'i thub dbang mi tshad ma gcig dang /mchims blo bzang grags kyi thugs dam gyi rten du grags pa'i li ma'i sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po'i snang brnyan mi tshad ma bcas dang / thub dbang dge 'dun 'phel gyi snang brnyan yang der bzhugs shing dus phyis paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi sku dus la bkra shis lhun por gdan 'dren zhus rjes der thub dbang dge 'dun 'phel gyi bzhugs khri tsam yod do/lha khang de'i steng gi byams khang ni rgya khyon ka ba drug dze k+ṣim las grub pa'i byams mgon/ gsung byon mar grags pa'i bzhengs sku mi tshad ma bzhugs pa'i g.yas g.yon du thub pa'i mdzad bcu rdo ka ma ru pa la brkos pa shin tu legs pa ngo mtshar can dkyus la kung tshon do tsam dang zheng la kung tshon phyed tsam yod pa re dang / gser zangs dang li ma'i sku brdikā brgya phrag brgal ba/ gzhan yang gnas brtan bcu drug la bya

shang shang gis phul ba'i lhung bzed ngo mtshar can g.yas su bskor bas pho skad dang g.yon du bskor bas mo skad 'abhon pa zhig dang / skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims kyis phyag rdor bsgrubs pa'i grub rtags su rdo nag la bzhag pa'i 'bas rjes shig kyang bzhugs/ byams pa mgon po'i sku brnyanade'i sngon gyi lo rgyus cung zad gleng na/ rten de ni gtsang shab tu 'khrungs pa gnyan lo dar ma grags kyi thugs dam gyi rten yin/ sngon rgya gar chu bo gāng gar rgyal po zhig gis rin po che du ma brdzis nas sang nyin bzo bo bi sha karmas bzhengs rgyu yin pa la de'i mtshan mo byams mgon dang sgrol ma gnyis rang byon du phebs/ skabs der nye gnas kyis rdo khra ril zhig snying rje rje ru mthong nas khyer bas/ der shing sdong zhig nas lo ma zhig zags te tshegs sha ka zhes pa'i sgra byung ba kho rang gis snyan par go nas ngag tu bgrang gin song bas/ byams mgon gyis de'i sgra skad la dug sbrul gyi sgo nga yin gsungs nas nye gnas de byams mgon dang sgrol ma gnyis kyi sku rgyab tu shog gsungs te sgul gyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa dang / nye gnas de'i zla bo zhig yod pa zangs mo che'i 'og tu sbas kyang dug sgrul nam phyed tsam la slebs nas mi'i dri tshor te zangs mo che la 'khrilabs mi de sha dab nas shi/ yang gen mo zhig la nga bal yul du skyel dang gsungs par/ rgas mos mi theg zhus pas/ nga'i jid tshad la bal 'dab ma gcig gi ljid tshad las med gsungs/ de nas chu bo gang gā brgyud nas phebs/ klu rnams kyis gdan 'dren skabs sgrol ma dang byams mgon gyi spyab yol rten skal du gnang / byams mgon gyis1 ༵ ni

sems can gyi don byed dgos gsungs nas bal yul du phebs/ bal yul du bzo grwa che mo zhig nas dbu dasbog dang rgyab yol phul zhing / de nasaganyan lo dz+dza ba dar ma grags kyi gdan sa shab dar lung du phebs/de nas khro phu brgyud de stag la'i la gsham du gsol 'tshal gnang bas der chu mig zhig byung bar la stod chu mig tu grags/ de nas chu mig lha khang du phebs pa na/ nga ni snar thang du mchims kyi sku rim du 'gro gsungs nas gdan rabs bdun pa mchims nam mkha' grags kyi sku dus su snar thang du phebs zhes de snga'i byams khang ldebs bris kyi yi ger yod skad/ de bzhin 'di'i sku dus su gter bdag pa'i mgon khang mdo phug gnyis gsar du bzhengs/ rgya khyon ka ba gnyis/ nang rten du mchims nam mkha' grags kyis gter bdag banyims bzhugs byas pa'i thub pa'i dbu gcig yod pa shing 'bo zhig gi nang dri bzang blugs pa'i 'bru dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol nas lo re'i rgya lo'i lo gsar nyin dmangs mjal gtong ba las rgyun bar dam rgya yin zhing / de la mi rnams kyis phyi lo'i dus babs bzang ngan gyi brtag dpyad kyang byed kyi yod/ gzhan yang lha khang de'i nang snar thang thog bub ma zhes pa'i grags can gyi thub pa'i snang brnyan gter thon khro par gcig dang / tshwa tshwa sgang kha ma'i khro par gter thon mar grags pa zhig kyang bzhugs/ mgon khang mdo'i rgya khyon ka ba gnyis/ der gser zangs las kub pa'i gter bdag khru gang tsam pa dang / sman 'jim ladi ṭ+wāṃb pa'i gter bdag sku lnga dang / dgu gtor skabs kyi 'cham

sems can gyi don byed dgos gsungs nas bal yul du phebs/ bal yul du bzo grwa che mo zhig nas dbu dasprug dang rgyab yol phul zhing / de nasaganyan lo dz+dza ba dar ma grags kyi gdan sa shab dar lung du phebs/de nas khro phu brgyud de stag la'i la gsham du gsol 'tshal gnang bas der chu mig zhig byung bar la stod chu mig tu grags/ de nas chu mig lha khang du phebs pa na/ nga ni snar thang du mchims kyi sku rim du 'gro gsungs nas gdan rabs bdun pa mchims nam mkha' grags kyi sku dus su snar thang du phebs zhes de snga'i byams khang ldebs bris kyi yi ger yod skad/ de bzhin 'di'i sku dus su gter bdag pa'i mgon khang mdo phug gnyis gsar du bzhengs/ rgya khyon ka ba gnyis/ nang rten du mchims nam mkha' grags kyis gter bdag bstems bzhugs byas pa'i thub pa'i dbu gcig yod pa shing 'bo zhig gi nang dri bzang blugs pa'i 'bru dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol nas lo re'i rgya lo'i lo gsar nyin dmangs mjal gastong ba las rgyun bar dam rgya yin zhing / de la mi rnams kyis phyi lo'i dus babs bzang ngan gyi brtag dpyad kyang byed kyi yod/ gzhan yang lha khang de'i nang snar thang thog bub ma zhes pa'i grags can gyi thub pa'i snang brnyan gter thon khro par gcig dang / tshwa tshwa sgang kha ma'i khro par gter thon mar grags pa zhig kyang bzhugs/ mgon khang mdo'i rgya khyon ka ba gnyis/ der gser zangs las thub pa'i gter bdag khru gang tsam pa dang / sman 'jim ladi snrob pa'i gter bdag sku lnga dang / dgu gtor skabs kyi 'cham

ba'i sgo pan zhig yod pa dang / sru ma dmar po'i ka 'phan rgya yig yod pa zhig kyang yodasne ri'i rnang dru gtsang khang dbus ma rgya khyon ka ba bcu/rten gyi gtso bo sku rgyu li ma las grub pa'i mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i snang brnyan thog tshad ma dang / gzhan yang mtha' skor du sku 'dra sna tshogs dang / bka' bstan skya bris cha tshang kha shas bcas bzhugs/ gtsang khang nub ma rgya khyon ka ba bzhi/ de'i nang bka' bstan gnyis kyi par shing bkrus pa'i snag tsha 'dres pa'i sman 'jim gyi thub dbang gtso 'khor mi tshad ma'i mtha' skor du bka' bstan skya chos cha tshang 'ga' zhig bzhugs/ gtsang khang shar ma rgya khyon ka ba gnyis/ rten gtsor sman 'jim las spub pa'i bla ma 'jam dga' ba'i snang brnyan mi tshad ma tsam gyi g.yas g.yon du chos rtsigs sngar bzhin bzhugs/ 'du khang nang gi mgon khang de ni skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims kyis nyi ma mig gis ma mthong bar lo bcu gcig ring bsnyen sgrub mdzad pa'i sgrub khang de yin la/der paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi bzhugs khri dang / gter thon du grags pa'i khro lung bco brgyad yod pa'i khro chen po zhig kyang yod/ par khang de'i nang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur pod brgya dang bcu med gnyis kyi par shing ngos grangs 5༷019dang / bstan 'gyur pod nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga'i par shing ngo grags 76726dang / ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i 'khrungs rabs mdzad brgya rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi sku thang sum cu so gcig gi par shing dang / rje btsun tsong kha pa'i 'didīs rabs brgyad cu'i sku thang gi par shing ngo grangs bco lnga/ thub

dbang gnas brtan bcu drug gi sku thang par shing ngo grangs bdun sogs bzhugs yul mchod khri dang bcas pa thog tshad ma bzhugs/ 'dis snar thang gi gtsug lag khang chen mo dang lcags ri tshen spro bzhengs/ /bcu gcig gdan rabs bcu gsum pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi skra dus/sku dus 'dir nye gnas pa snyan grags bzang pos mkhan chen blo bzang grags kyi gdung rten bkra shis sgo mang mtho tshad thog tshad lnga tsam yod pa de bzhengs/ de'i nang bzhugs su sangs rgyas glang po'i skye ba bzhes skabs kyi mche ba ya gcig dang / nyan thos mchog zung gi gsol lhung dang 'khar gsil/ chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis nyin gcig la mchod rten bye ba bzhengs pa'i gras kyi bka' gdams mchod rten bzhi bcu dang / sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel bre bo che gang / gzhan yang dam pa mang po'i byin rlabs kyi rten dang gdung rus ji mang bzhugs/ phyi'i lcags ri bar par gyang rim pa bcu bzhi yod pa de yang brtsigs shing /mtho tshad la kung khre 9dang tshon 8yod/ dgon phyi'i rgya khyon ni lcags ri'i lho nas byang bar kung khre 1ṭ+wāṃ1dang tshon 2dang / nub nas shar bar kung khre 22༷dang tshon 5yod/ gnas bcu lha khang (phyis dge 'dun pa rnams kyi 'du khang mdzad pa )ni mchims blo bzang grags kyi dgongs rdzogs su bzhengs/ rgya khyon ka ba bco lnga/ nang gi gtsang khang rgya khyon ka ba gnyis/ rten gtsor mchims blo bzang grags kyi sdosnas

dam rten sman 'jim las grub pa'i thub pa tshul khrims ma zhes pa mi tshad tsam dang / mtha' skor du sman 'jim las grub pa'i gnas bcu brag ri ma rgyal chen/ dharma/ ha shang dang bcas pa/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gser chos cha tshang / 'du khang du bka' 'gyur skya chos cha tshang / de'i gtso bor dngul gar blug gi sgrol ma gser zangs kyi khri rgyab yol ldan pa khru gang tsam dang / 'du khang gi dbus su paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs khri/ de'i g.yas su sman 'jim gyi tsong kha pa'i sku brnyan mi tshad ma gcig dang / bzhugs khri'i sku rgyab tu 'dul 'dzin dpal ldan bzang po'i pur ras kyi gzhir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bris sku thog tshad ma gcig bcas bzhugs/ 'du khang gi ldebs ngos su gnas bcu cha tshang gnyis/ mgon khang nang du sman 'jim las thub pa'i chos skyong yongs rdzogs kyi snang brnyan byis pa lo brgyad kyi tshad tsam las bzhi'i 'azin las bsgrub pa'i phyir bzhugs su gsol/ khang steng du gser zangs kyi gardzir gcig dang / rnga ral gyi thugs drug bcas 'dzugs par mdzad/ ka sgrug rgya khyon ka ba bzhi tsam gyi skya ldebs ngos su rgyal chen bzhi dang / rje mi la ras pa/ srid pa 'khor lo cha lnga pa bcas kyi tshon ris rnam par bkra ba/ 'du khang gi phyi skya'i lho ngos kyi shar nas bgrang ba'i rtsigs pa'i 'bar 'bur bdun par gsang chur grags pa bod zla dgu pa'i 'jigs byedakyi sgrub mchod thub ma thag mi ser rnams kyi phyi lo'i lo brtag byed pa'i gsang chu 'bab pa mi kun gyi mngon sum mthong chos kyi yul du ñcar pa rdospya do/ bla ma lha khang ni dus phyis bzhengs par mngon zhing / rgya

khyon ka ba gnyis/ nang rten du chos sde 'di'i bla rabs mchims nam mkha' grags gtso bzhugs kyi sman 'jim las thub pa'i snang brnyan gzhon nu lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshad can nyi shu bzhugs shing / khang steng du gser zangs kyi gardzi ra gcig dang / gter bdag pa'i zangs thug dang bcas thug drug ras kyi rgyal mtshan gcig bcas 'dzugs par mdzad/ thang la brag skyes su grags pa sngar jo bo rjes lung bstan mdzad skabs kyi gser srung 'khor ba'i gnas de yin pas de nas dad ldan rnams kyis brag de nas yun ring byin rlabs kyi rten du khyer ba'i rkyen ram̐sna /t+na dṛ ṭ+wāṃ r+sha na// /de srung ba'i phyir dus phyis der khang bu brtsegs pa bcu gnyis/ snar thang ginangarten skor/nang rten thad bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i rten dam 'byar ma yinaspus dmigs bsal can 'ga' re ma gastogs dmangs kyis mjal mi chog pa'i dngos po rtsa che ba sha stag yin/ de yang 'phags pa klu sgrub klu yul du phebs skabs klu rnams kyis rten skal du phul ba'i klu 'jim gyi thub dbang gtso 'khor gsum par leb tshon gang tsam pa dngul gyi bzhugs khang dang bcas pa gcig dang / rdo ka ma ru pa la 'bur bskos kyi thub pa'i mdzad bcu tshon do tsam yod pa shubs bcas gcig dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel 'khrul med rgya sran tsam nang bsnyik+tas

kyi khro'i mchod rten kung tshon gsum tsam yod pa gcig bcom ldan rig ral gyi tshems ring bsrel shubs dang bcas pa gcig skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims kyi thugs dam rten mgon po gur gyi sku thang gcig 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi thugs dam rten sku thang rnying song rnams kyi 'thum bu thel 'byar gnyis/ 'brom ston pa'i phyag 'khar tshegs nyi shu rtsa gcig la sgrol ma nyer gcig tshang ba tog byu'i cin che ba gcig la sangs rgyas stong tshang bar grags pa/ dge bshes po to ba'i phyag 'khar mtsho glang gi rwa co gcig dang / rdo ston shes rab grags kyi tsan dan gyi phyag 'khar la ba so'i 'bur dkris can gcig gnas brtan bcu drug dang / gtum ston 'od yug ram lding pa 'byung gnas rdo rje/ 'od yug brag dkar ba sems dpa' chen po bcas kyi zhabs lham kha shas bcas nang rten gras su bzhugs/ /bcu gsum/ chos sde'i grwa tshang gi skor/chos sde 'dir sngar dpal 'bar dang zur khang zer ba'i sde khag gnyis yod pa la phyis khang pa gsar rgyag byas pa dang chabs cig khron sbrug grwa tshang dang / legs bshad gling grwa tshang zhes pa'i ming btags pa'o/ khron spug grwa tshang gi 'du khang rgya khyon ka ba bcu gnyis/ de'i nang gigatsang khang ka ba gnyis/ rten gyi gtso bo sman 'jim las grub pa'i rgyadi ༵ mi pham mgon po'i snang brnyan mi tshad ma dang / mtha' skor du

gnas bcu dang tā ming yig drug 'khod pa'i dngul gar blug gi sgrol ma tshon do tsam yod pa gcig bka' 'gyur skya chos cha tshang kun dga' rwa ba dang bcas pa bzhugs/ de bzhin shar gyi ldebs ngos su chos rgyal nang sgrub gtso bzhugs kyi dregs pa pho brgyad mo brgyad kyi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshon ris bkra ba'i ri mo dang / nub kyi ldebs ngos su rigs gsum mgon po'i ldebs bris kyang yod/ mgon khang ni rgya khyon ka ba gcig nang rten du 'jim pa las grub pa'i gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos gtsos chos srung gi tshogs dang / bskang tshus dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas legs par bshams pa'i khang steng du pho lha gcig dang /thug bzhi yang 'dzugs par mdzad/ legs bshad gling grwa tshang gi 'du khang rgya khyon ni ka ba bcu drug rten gyi gtso bo snan 'jim las pib pa'i rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i snang brnyan mi tshad ma gcig dang /mtha' skor du gnas bcu/ rgyal chen/ dge bsnyen/ ha shang bcas dang sman 'jim las grub pa'i 'dul 'dzin dpal ldan bzang po'i snang brnyan mi tshad ma/ bka' 'gyur skya chos cha tshang bzhugs yul shing gi grwa mig dang bcas pa bzhugs/ shar gyi ldebs ngos su 'dul 'dzin dpal ldan bzang po'i shangs khrag gis bris pa'i lha mo dmag zor ma'i ldebs bris shin tu bka' gnyan pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba zhig dang mtha' skor du dus bzhi'i lha mo tshe ring mched lnga bcas kyi ri mo yang yod/khang steng du pho lha gcig dang thug bzhi yang 'dzugs par mdzad/ /19

bcu bzhi/ chos lugasashā byed sgo'i skor/gdan rabs dang po gtum ston blo gros grags nas bzung bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung gis zin pa bcus gtsos gdan rabs nyi shu po thams cad ni tshul khrims rnam par dag cing sde snod la nang byan tshud pa/ 'chal pa dang / dam sel/ 'dres 'khyer bcas kyis ma bslad pa/bshes gnyen ston pa nas brgyud pa'i rnam thar dri med 'dzin pa sha stag yin/ sngon dus chos sde 'dir bka' gdams gzhung pa ba'i bshad srol la brten nas dbyar dgun gnyis tshogs chos su bslab spyod gnyis gsung bar mdzad cing / sgog chos su mchims nam mkha' grags kyis mdzadapa'i lam mchog dang / rdo ston shes rab grags kyis mdzad pa'i de'i 'grel pa la brten nas byang chub lam gyi sgron mas skyes bu gsum gyi lam la 'khrid par mdzad pa'i phyag len ma nyams par yod cing /gzhan yang lcags ri'i nang du khyi dang / dud 'gro mi brten pa dang /nag khrims dang chang khrims/ sha khrims bcas dam par mdzad pa sogs 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams bzhin phyag len legs par mdzad/ tshogs su don zhags kyi gzungs sgrub dang / skye bo stong phrag mang por bum pa'i byinarlabs/ dus bzang la sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga lo dus kyi byams pa gsung 'byon ma'i drung du byams pa'i smon lam/ mgon po'i bgā~Xgaso/ gtor thab sogs spyi sgos kyi mdzad srol rnams ma nyams

par gnas pas bka' gdams pa'i bstan pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyi mdzadaspol gtso bo zhig tu gyur pa yin te/ glegs bam las/ dpal chos kyi thang zhes grags pa 'byung zhes dang / 'on kyang lnga brgya'i mtha' mar yang / /bstan pa'i me ro de na gnas/ / rgyal ba mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /ring bsrel skye rgus mchod par byed sogs rgya cher lung bstan to/gzhanaming chos sde 'dir bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri sogs dang / nye ba'i dus rabs su'ang rje shes rab seng ge dang / rgyal ba dge 'dun grub la sogs pa'i skyes chen dam pa mang du byon zhing / rje shes rab seng ges stod du srad rgyud dang / dbus su smad rgyud btsugs pa/ rje dge 'dun grub kyis kyang gtsang du bkra shis lhun po'i chos sde chen po de nyid 'debs par mdzad/ de dag gi ma dgon ni snar thang gi chos sde 'di nyirda yin pa shes par bya'o/ sngon dus chos sde 'dir gzhung chen bka' pod rnam lnga'i rtsod grwa shin tu dar ba dang / dus phyis gzhi gsum gyi phyag len lte bar byas pa'i lo ltar 'jigs byed dang / kun rigs/ tshe chog sman bla bcas kyi sgrub mchod dang / gnas brtan phyag mchod/ chos skyong yongs rdzogs kyi bskang gso bcas kyi phyag len ma nyams pa yod/khyad par snar thang bum dbang zhes pa thub chen snya na dha ra'i bum chen brgyad kyi nang tshan zhig yod pa de nyid dbe+en gnas byang chub chen po'i dge slong rnams kyis don zhags kyi sgo nas bskubs te bod zla 2tshes 14nyin par khang chen mor ser skya stong phrag mang por bum pa de'i byin rlabs dang / skyabs mgon chen po paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi swā ḍim

la brten nas tshe dbang bskur ba dang / tshe 15nyin gdugs dang ba dan sogs kyi mchod rdzas dang / dung rgya rnga rol sogs kyi spyan 'dren sngon bsu dang 'brel rten khyad par can 'ga' zhig gling skor la gdan 'dren zhu ba dang / phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po chen po bzhi la'ang mchod gtor 'bul zhing zin las bcol ba'i srol lam yod/ dge 'dun pa rnams la nyin ltar tshogs thun bzhi chag med dang / lo re'i nang chos thog brgyad/ de'i ring sku rim 'phar ma yang yod/ lo ltar bod zla 12tshes 29nyin lcags mkhar gtor rgyag dang 'azel ba'i dgu gtor 'cham gzigs thog ser skya pho mo'i tshogs rgyan gos gzab 'chor dang ṭ+wā/dī shā rnyi sdo r+shal/ da/nga 'azel spro skyid kyi rnam pa'i dga' ston la longs su bco lnga/ chos sde'i 'dus sde3ma bzhin 'phelatwas byung chul/gong du brjod zin pa ltar thog ma bzhi grwa nas bzung dus phyis sum stong tsam du 'phel bas tshogs khang gi ming la yang sum stong sdings zhes grags pa dang / de nas rim bzhin 'phel te skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims kyi skabs la dge 'dun pa khri tsam bar 'phel rgyas byung bas de skabs kyi tshogs khang ni dus phyis par khang chen mor grags pa de yin/de nas dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i sgad paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa'i sku dus la kāsngi 'dun pa zhal grangs nyis brgya tshad gzhir mdzad nas skabs der

tshogs khang yang gnas bcu lha khang du byas/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i /ga/ sa/ byi (196༷)lor sbebs du zhal grangs 17༷tsam las med bcu drug chos sde'i gagisaka dang 'cho ba'iyongakhungs skor/gdan rabs nyi shu pa'i rjes tsam nas lo 16༷lhag gi ring chos sde 'di'i bstan srid dpal 'byor gang ci'i thad ches nyams rgud du song ba dang / de nas paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dgung grangs brgyad cu lhag tsam la phebs skabs/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po dang / gu thi bstan 'dzin chos rgyal/ sde srid bsod nams rab brtan bcas kyis snar thang mthil pa dang / phyug gzhung khang gsar/lha khud lha chung / gur me dang / gcen lung gru gsar sogs phul ba nas chos sde 'di bkra shis lhun po'i khongs su chod cing / de nas paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes dgung lo drug cu lhag tsam bzhes skabs/ chos sder dag ther dang / dge 'dun gyi zhal grangs dang /'tsho ba'i yong khungs bcas gtan khel mdzad de nyams pa slar gso'i phyag rjes bzang po 'jog gnang mdzad pa dang / gzhis khongs de dag gi yong 'bab thog nas lo re'i chos thog brgyad la dge 'dun rer zla phogs 'bru khal gsum re dang / chos thog gsar mar yang 'bru khal gsum re yod cing / nyin ltar tshogs thun bzhi re chag med/ grwa rdoṭā so

so nas kyang dge 'dun rer lo rer 'bru khal gsum re yod/ gtor spos nyin bzhi'i ring grwa tshang so sor chos sde'i grwa pa yongs rdzogs tshogs bzhugs byed srol yod/ zla ba 1tshes 15nas bzung grwa tshang so sor grwa ja zhes pa zla ba gnyis tsam ring tshogs thun gcig la bka' 'gyur gsung sgrog mdzad srol yod/ gtsug lag khang dang lha khang gi rgyun ldan dkar ṭ+wāṃspra tram̐ zlo shā ༵kyā /ni 'a/ brog gur me nas lo rer mar khal 7rkyaXtsam yong ba bcu bdun/ bsdoms migadapal snar thang gi chos sde chen po 'di nyid ni rab byung gsum pa'i chu bya/ rab lo 127(1152)lor gtum ston blo gros grags kyis thog ma phyag btab pa nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags byi (196༷)lo bar lo ṭ+wāṃX7song nas bcu med brgyad pa'i steng na yod pa'i go rim nang rim bzhin 'phel rgyas su phyin te dus skabs der snar thang chos sde'i phyi'i khor yug gi rgya khyon la kung khre 825dang tshon 6yod pa dang / lcags ri'i mtho tshad la kung khye 9tshon rayod/ der tshoms chenagasum tshud pa'i lha khang bco lnga/ par khang chen mor khor yug rgya khyon kung khre 162dang / grwa tshang 2gdan rabs rim byung gi gdung rten 12dang / bcom ldan rig ral gyi gdung rten 1thang la brag skyes kyi ji~X bu brtsegs pa tshud pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa 2gser chos pod

224skya chos par ma pod 521bka' 'gyur par shing ngo grangs 5༷༷19bstan 'gyur par shing ngo grangs 76726mdzad brgya'i thang par ngo grangs 21tsong kha brgyad cu'i thang par ngo grangs 15gnas bcu'i thang par ngo grangs 7rdo rje gcod pa dang de'i phan yon gyi dpe thung par shing cha tshang / mchims blo bzang grags kyis mdzad pa'i gnas brtan phyag mchod kyi par shing ngo grangs 1༷mgon po gri khug pa'i bskangagaso'i par shing ngo grangs 9gter bdag pa'i bskang gso'i par shing ngo grangs 5rje dge 'dun grub sku ngo mas bzhengs pa'i ma ṇi khri skor ma che ba 2spyi khang rtse shod dang brang khang 26khang steng gser zangs kyi gardzir 5thug grangs 42dar chen grangs 6lcags ri'i phyi rol du bum pa chen po 2bcas bzhugs pa'i chos grwa chen po dpal snar thang pa zhes ṭ+wāṃkāsdu kāsdi /du/sna //kar/ srid gsum gyi bla na 'phags pa de nyid da lta 25

gnyisapa/ dpalasnar thang gi gdan rabasanyi shu'i rnamathar mdor bsdus/gcig gtum ston blo gros gragasaspyi rnam thar mdor bsdus/glegs bam las/ blo gros mtshan ldan mtshungs pa med/ /ces pa ltar/ gtum ston blo gros grags ni rab byung gnyis pa'i me khyi (11༷6)lor shab sgo lnga'i lcags mkhar rtse'i dbu mang du sku 'khrungs/gdung rus gtum yin/ rngog mtsho'i mkhan po ldog pa chen po'i mkhan bu rgya 'dul la dam pa'i chos 'dul ba legs par bslab ste 'dul ba'i bshad pa'ang mdzad/ de nas dbus su byon te dge bshes sha ra ba chen po lo bcu'i bar du bsten cing mnyes par mdzad nas bka' gdams pa'i yon tan ma lus pa bugs su chud/ dge bshes sha ra ba'i bka' babs kyi bu chen bzhi'i nang nas rnam thar gyi bka' babs chen por gyur/chukhya nas bzung lo bcu bzhi'i bar snar thang gi gdan sa mdzad/ de nas rdo ston shes rab grags gdan sar bsko bzhag gnang ste la stod byang girta sde chos lung du byon nas thugs dam mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gardikā bzhes pa rab byung gsum pa'i me khyi (1166)lo'i rgyal gyi zla

ba'i tshes 22nyin mya ngan las 'das/ ('di la chos lung sku gshegs kyang zhu )gdung rten ni byams khang gi shar gyi spyang sbyag nang du bzhugs/gnyis/ rdo ston shesarab gragasaklirnam tharasador bsdus/glegs bam las/ shes rab mtshan ldan kun la mkhas/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo ston shes rab grags ni rab byung gnyis pa'i me mo lus (1127)lor shab kyi drang mda'i thu lung du sku 'khrungs/ dge bshes gong ma nyid kyis legs par bskyangs nas bka' gdams kyi gdam pa ma lus pa thugs su chud/ dgung lo bzhi bcu'i thog snar thang gi gdan sa mdzad de lnga bcu rtsa dgu'i bar lo nyi shu'i ring tshogs dpon mdzad pas snar thang ba chen po zhes phyogs thams cad du grags pas khyab/ tshogs pa'ang che bar bsdus shing bka' gdams kyi bstan pa nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad/ dastang grangs nga dgu bzhes pa rab ṭ+wāṃng/sumapa'i shing shāṭā sgoṭ+wāṃpy-i ṭ+wāṃrterdo bye / / sdo / drosnas 'a ṭ+wāṃ/sa// gdung tshon gdan sa dang gsum/ zhang btsun rdorje 'od zer gyi rnam tharasador bsdus/glegs bam las/ rdo rje mtshan ldan mi nub 'dzin/ /ces pa ltar/zhang btsun rdo rje 'od zer ni rab byung gnyis pa'i chu stag (112/2)

lor shab stod dar lung gi ra zhags su sku 'khrungs/ gdung rus zhang yin/ dge bshes glang ri thang pa'i sku'i skye bar grags/ gtum ston dang rdo ston chen po gnyis kyis legs par bskyangs/ bka' gdams pa'i rnam thar dri ma med pa 'dzin cing spel ba'i skyes bu chen po zhig tu gyur/ lo brgyad ring gdan sa bskyangs/ dgung grangs 72bzhes pa rab byung gsum pa'i shing stag (1194)lo'i sgron zla'i tshe 14nyin mya ngan las 'das/ gdung rten mkhan rabs gdung rten bzhugs yul ṭā/ṅgi ༵ ṭ+wāṃ /bde/ chen thar pa gling gi nub nas brtsis pa'i dang po na bzhi/ gro ston bdud rtsi gragasashā rnam tharamodor bsdus/glegs bam las/ bdud rtsi'i mtshan ldan dpal mnga' ba/ /zhes pa ltar/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags ni rab byung gsum pa'i chu bya (1152)lor chu sgo lum du sku 'khrungs/ gdung rus gro yin/ rtsis pa gzhon nu seng ge las bsnyen par rdzogs/ rdo ston chen po dang zhang btsun rdo rje 'od zer las sha ra ba las brgyud pa'i gdam pa ma lus pa mnos shing / lum pa ba'i thugs sras chu mig pa shes rab grags pa las ka ma ba'i lam gyi rim pa yang gsan nas/ snar thang gi lam rim 'di la sha ra ba dang / ka ma ba'i gdam pa gnyis ka tshang bar yod/ gzhan yadā hā yul pa'i slob ma mu sman pa chen po dang / sangs rgyas dbon ston

sogs mkhas grub du ma bsten nas gsan pa rgya chen po mdzad/ sangs rgyas stong gi ya gyal zhig tu grags/ byang rwa sgrong du 'bul mo che thengs gsum mdzad de rwa sgrong dbu rtse rin po che'i steng du gser tog khams gsum zil gnon bzhengs/ lam mchog gi rtsa ba tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang ljags rtsom mdzad de lam gyi rim pa'i sgo nas skal ba ldan pa rnams rjes su bzung / 'di 'azin las dar khyab che zhing snar thang gi dpal mgon yang 'di'i sku ring la byung / gnas brtan bcu drug gdan 'dzoms pa sogs kyi lo rgyus ni don tshan dang po'i nang du brjod zin pas 'dir mi bshad do/ gdan sa lo 29mdzad de dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa rab byung bzhi pa'i chu 'brug (1222)lo'i sa zla'i mar ngo'i tshes 9nyin sku mya ngan las 'das/ gdung rten ni gdan sa gsum pa'i gdung rten gyi shar na bzhugs so/ /lnga/ mnga' bdag chosarje chosashā blama'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/glegs bam las/ chos kyi bla ma chos kyi rje/ / zhes pa ltar/mnga' bdag chos rje chos kyi bla ma ni rab byung gsum pa'i shing 'brug (1184)lor shab sgo'i lnga'i sna ring du sku 'khrungs/ dpal ldan gro mo che las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan po gong ma gnyis nas gdam ngag phal mo che gsan te mkhyen pa shin tu ciche bas zhang thams cad mkhyekā ༵ra

grags/ 'dis mdzad pa'i bshes gnyen ston pa'i rnam thar yod cing /poto ba dang sha ra ba'i rnam thar yang 'dis mdzad tshod/ gdan sa lo bcu mdzad de dgung lo 58bzhes pa rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags glang (1241)lo'i sa zla'i tshes 21nyin mya ngan las 'das/ gdung rten ni gdan sa bzhi pa'i gdung rten bar du bzhugs so/ /drug sangs0sa sgom pa seng ge skyabs kyirnam thararmodor bsdus/glegs bam las/ thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba 'dzin/ / ces pa ltar sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs ni rab byung gsum pa'i sa mo phag (1179)lor lcags kyi skyo lung dro'i phu kha'u bya bar gsang sngags rnying ma'i slob dpon zhig gi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dpal ldan gro mo che las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan po gong ma gnyis las gdam ngag ma lus pa gsan/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum bzhes pa lcags glang lor gdan sar phebs/ blo sbyong tshogs bshad pa zhes bya ba rmad du byung ba'i legs bshad cig kyang rtsom par mdzad/ gdan sa lo bcu'i bar du bskyangs/de nas mchims nam mkha' grags kyi mdun du sba 'khar btsugs te dge slong nam mkha' grags/ de ring nas 'o skol gnyis stan gcig la 'dug pa yin no/ zhes gsungs nas rang nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu bsko bzhasdu mdzad/ de nas kun spang mdzad de rta shi lung zhes pa byang chub

chen po'i dbe+en gnas su phebs skabs dge 'dun pa rnams kyis skyel ma zhus pas sa mtshams su bla mas ma ṇi skul cig gsungs pa la deng dus kyangaspa ṇi skul zhes su grags pa'i rdo phung zhig kyang yod/ bla ma 'dis skal ldan gyi gdul bya grangs las 'das pa zhig smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad nas mthar dgung lo don gnyis pa rab byung bzhi pa'i lcagasakhyi (125༷)lo'i dpyid zla tha chung gi tshes 15nam phyed yol la mya ngan las 'das/ de nas bla ma'i zhal chems ltar gdung rten gnyis su bgos te gcig brag skyibs mngon gsal che ba zhig tu byang chub chen po'i mchod rten nang du bzhugs su gsol ba'i gnas de la byang chub chen po'idaben gnas (byang chen sgang ri )zhes grags pa yin no/ gdung rten gcig ni chos sde'i gdung rten gyi gral bzhi pa na zhugs so/ /bdun/ mchims nam mkha' gragasashā rnam thar mdor bsdus/glegs bam las/ nam mkha' lta bur kun khyab pa'i/ / kun mkhyenaganyis pas 'gro ba 'dzin/ /ces pa ltar/ mchims nam mkha' grags ni rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags rta (121༷)lor myang stod smon 'gro'ikha'ur chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi blon po mchims rdo rje sprel chung gi rgyud du sku 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung / dpal gro mo che las bsnyen par rdzogs/ dpal ldan gro dang / zhang ston/ mardosdus

blo brtan/ mnyam med sangs rgyas sgom pa ba bzhi las bka' gdams pa'i chos skor rnams kyi bka' drin mnos/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bkra shis sgang pa la byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan las brgyud pa'i lta ba'i man ngag la sogs pa gsan pas bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ gtsug lag ma lus pa la legs par sbyangs pas mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs par gyur te chos mngon pa mdzod kyi ṭik+ka chen po (mchims mdzod )la sogs pa'i rtsom pa rmad du byung ba mang du mdzad cing gro mo ches mdzad pa'i lam rim rtsa tshig tshigs bcad ma la lung rigs kyis brgyan pa'i 'grel pa khrid yig lam mchog rin po che zhes bya ba zhig kyang mdzad/ chu mig chos 'khor gyi gral gtso yang mdzad de 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa sogs gangs can gyi che rgya thams cad kyis mchod cing bkur/ skyel nag brag seng dang / rgyang ro mkhas pa paṇa chen/ bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri la sogs pa'i slob ma mang du byon/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi ya gyal zhig dang sangs rgyas sgan pa'i rgyal po'i sprul par grags shing bstan pa'i rtsa lag chen po dang mchims thams cad mkhyen pa zhes mkhas pa'i grags pas sa steng ma lus par khyab par mdzad/ byams mgon gsung byon ma yang 'di'i sku dus su phebs/ lo so drug gi bar du gdan sa bskyangs nas dgung lo 76pa/ rab byung lnga pa'i shing bya (1285)sbya ༵ / / sbya / sna /14/la sku mya ngan las 'das/ gdung brten lnga pa g.yu 32

bachud/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrimasashā rnam thar mdor bsdus/glegs bam las/ smon lam dag cing tshul khrims ldan/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog tu 'gyur/ / zhes pa ltar/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims ni rab byung bzhi pa'i sa yos (1219)lor g.yas ru'i byang gi rta nag yang yul du sku 'khrungs/ gdung rus skyo yin/ dge bshes gong ma gnyis las bka' gdams kyi gdam pa ma lus pa gsan/ 'dis nyi ma mig gis ma mthong bar lo bcu gcig gi ring phyag na rdo rje'i bsnyen pa mdzad pas mthu stobs che bas gzhan gyi nad gdon bsal ba sogs kyi lo rgyus mang du snang / bla ma 'di phyag rdor dang / sgom pa ba spyan ras gzigs/ mchims chen mo 'jam pa'i dbyangs te rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phul du grags/ 'dis phar phyin gyi 'grel pa zhig kyang mdzad/ snar thang gi gtsug lag khang chen mo dang / phyi'i lcags ri chen mo yang bzhengs/ 'brom ku ma ra ma ti dang / bcom ldan rig ral yang 'di'i slob mar gyur/ gdan sa lo 12mdzad de dgung lo ṭ+wāṃ1bzhes pa/rab byung lnga pa'i sa phag (1299)lo'i dbo zla'i tshes 14la sku mya ngan kās/ 'a/das/ gdung rten ni nub nas brtsis pa'i drug pa na bzhugs 33

dgu/ mkhan chen nyisargyalasatshan gyi rnam tharasador bsdus/glegs bam las/ tsha zer dpal ldan mtshan mnga' zhing / /gsum grags tha mar 'gro ba 'dzin/ /ces pa ltar/ mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan ni rab byung bzhi pa'i shing bya (1225)lor snar thang gi phu'i steng karma kha rir sku khrungs/ gdung rus ram yin/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung / 'brom ku ma ra las gligs bam cha lag dang bcas pa gsan cing / khyad par mchims dang skyo ston pa gnyis nas gdam pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bka' drin mnos/ 'dis tshul khrims stag brgyas bskos/ chos khrims kyang dam par mdzad/ gdan sa lo bdun bar du bskyangs nas dgung lo 81bzhes pa/ rab byung lnga pa'i shing sbrul (12༷5)lo'i sa zla'i tshes 24la sku mya ngan las 'das/ gdung rten gdan sa gong ma'i gdung rten gyi shar na bzhugs so/ /bcu/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa brtson 'grusaspyi rnam tharatsador bsdus/'dul 'dzin grags pa brtson 'thus ni rab byung bzhi pa'i chu glang (1252)lor myang stod rgya brag spel stod kyi chu mig lung bya bar sku 'asdokās/ gdung rus ze'u yin/ gdan sa ma mdzad gong du rgya yul du

byon/ se chen jim gyi ol byang du rgyal bu'i bla mchod mdzad/ de nas yar phebs te shing sbrul (12༷5)lo nas gdan sa lo bcu gnyis mdzad de dgung lo 64bzhes pa rab byung lnga pa'i me 'brug (1216)lorasku mya ngan las 'das/ sku shin tu btsun par grags so/ kha cig gis glegs bam las/ bsod nams mchog gi mtshan ldan pas/ /bstan pa'i me ro gso bar byed/ gsungs pa'i lung bstan ni/ 'di'i sku dus kho na snar thang du longs spyod che bas bsod nams mtshan dang ldan pa 'di la brnyes pa yin zer ba dang /yang kha cig gis snar thang spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan la phul ba la bsams nas de nyid yin zer ba dang / gzhan dag snar thang mkhan po zhig gi mtshan la bsod nams dar zhes pa zhig byung bas de yin zer ba snang yang / mkhan chen grub pa shes rab zhes pa ltar bar gyi gdan sa lnga dor ba'i mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub pa'i lung bstan du gsungs pa ni 'thad par sems so/ gdung rten ni gdan sa gong ma'i gdung rten gyi byang na bzhugs/ / bcu gcig mkhan chen grags pa shesarabashā rnam tharasador bsdus/mkhan chen grags pa shes rab ni rab byung bzhi pa'i sa lug (1259)lor sku 'khrungs/ mchims nam mkha' grags dang dīḍil

'dzin grags pa brtson 'aspus sogs yongs 'dzin du ma bsten nas bka' gdams kyi gzhung man ngag rnams gsan/ gdan sar lo bcu gcig bzhugs ring skal ldan gyi skye bo du ma smin grol gyi lam du bkod de dgung lo 67bzhes pa shing glang (1225)lor sku sbya ngan las 'das/gdung rten ni gdan sa gong ma'i nub na bzhugs so/ /bcu gnyis/ mchims sgro bzang gragasat+pa rnam tharatsador bsdus/mchims blo bzang grags ni rab byung lnga pa'i sa phag (1299)lor sbyang stod smon 'gro'i kha'ur mchims kyi rigs su 'khrungs/ mkhan chen 'dul 'dzin pa dang / mkhan chen grags pa shes rab/ rgyang ro byang 'bum la sogs pa'i yongs 'dzin du ma gtsug tu bzhes te gzhung gdam ngag ma lus pa thugs su chud par mdzad/ rab byung drug pa'i me glang (1227)lo nas lo 29bar gdan sa bskyangs te 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad/ mdo smad pa chos rje don thub rin chen la khyod kyi gdul bya mdo smad du yod pas der song la/bya khyung dang sha sprang dgon thob shig lhag tu khye'u ngo mtshar can zhig 'byung bas de nyid mig 'bras ltar gces par skyongs/ nga'i ming 'di khye'u de la thogs shig ces tsong kha pa 'khrungs pa'i lung bstan gsal bar mardokā/ chos rje don grub rin chen gyis bla ma'i bka' dang du bzhes

nas mdo smad du phebs shing chos grwa chen po bya khyung dgon sogs btab/'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa sku 'khrungs ma thag tu spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar bskyangs/ rim bzhin bskyed bsrings te dgung lo bdun la phebs pa na rab tu byung ste bla ma'i gsungs bzhin mtshan yang blo bzang grags pa zhes gsol bar mdzad do/ gzhan yang chos sder sha khrims dang pham pa mi bsten pa la sogs pa'i khrims dam par mdzad/ gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol gyi lam la bkod de dgung lo 77bzhes pa rab byung drug pa'i shing yos (1275)lor sku mya ngan las 'das/ gdung rten bkra shis sgo mang chen po 'di yin/ /bcu gsum/ mapa~X /pristasna shākā/shāl/ratshan gyi mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan ni rab byung drug pa'i sa stag (122ṭ+wāṃ) lor chu sgo'i khung bya bar gro'i rigs su sku 'khrungs/mchims blo bzang grags pa las bka' gdams pa'i gdam pa rnams rdzogs par gsan/ dka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge las kyang gdam pa gzhan mang po gsan/ rab byung drug pa'i shing mo yos (1275)lor gdan sar phebs/ bslab btus kyi ṭik+ka la sogs pa'i rtsom pa mang du mdzad/ rje btsun tsong kha pa chen pos kyang zhabs la gtugs/ mkhan chen blo bzang grags pa'i gcung po chen po snyan gragagabazang swālha nye

gnas chen po'i go sar bzhugs nas bstan pa'i zhabs tog du ma mdzad cing / khyad par dkar phugs la so nam mdzad nas nang du gnas brtan lha khang dang / mkhan chen blo bzang grags pa'i gdung rten bkra shis sgo mang gi mchod rten chen po dang / phyi'i lcags ri chen mo gyang rim pa bcu bzhi yod pa de yang bzhengs par mdzad/ gdan sa lo nyer bdun bskyangs te dgung grangs re bzhi bzhes pa/ rab byung bdun pa'i lcags 'brug (14༷༷)lor mya ngan 'da' tshul bstan/ /bcu bzhi/ mkhan chen grub pa shesarabat+pa rnam tharasador bsdus/mkhan chen thub pa shes rab ni rab byung drug pa'i me bya (1257)lor snar thang gi nye 'khor rong gu zhes bya bar dbang gi rigs su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo 7la klog yig mkhas par mkhyen/dgung lo 1༷par mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan nas rab tu byung /mtshan spub pa shes rab tu gsol/ dgung lo 2༷par bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ mkhan po de nyid dang / slob dpon grags pa rgya mtsho/chos rje yon tan 'od/ slob dpon skal ba bzang po sogs yongs 'dzin du bzhes nas/ mdo dang / rgyud sde/ man ngag gi skor rnams legs par gsan cing bugs su chud par mdzad/ khyad par mkhan chen kukā spyaga' rgyal mtshan las bka' gdams kyi skor rnams rdzogs par

mnos/ dgung lo 22bzhes pa/ sa 'brug lor gdan sa'i khrir phebs/gzhungadang gdam ngag gi sgo nas mkhas pa rnams kyi thugs yid tshims paraspadzad cing skye bo rnams la'ang thar pa'i sa bon btab par mdzad/dpal yid bzang rtse ba dang rje shes rab seng ges kyang zhabs la gtugs/thams cad mkhyin pa dge 'dun spub kyis kyang de las dge bsnyen dang /dge tshul/ dge slong / gsang sngags kyi sdom pa bcas mnos shing zab chos kyang mang du gsan to/ mkhan chen de la ming gong mas phul ba'i spu ma dmar po'i ka 'phan rgya yig dang bcas pa zhig kyang yod/ de bzhin rje 'di la gong mas phul ba'i sgo 'phan zhig yod pa par khang chen mo'i gdungadabus su bkal nas yod/ brtsams chos ni spyod 'jug gi ṭik+ka sogasayod/ gdan sa lo bcu bskyangs te sa pho khyi la nyid kyi dbon po bsod nams mchog thub gdan sar bsko bzhag mdzad de lo lnga'i bar zur bzhugs mdzad/ dgung lo 67bzhes pa/ rab byung bdun pa'i chu yos (1422)lo'i nag zla'i tshes 21gi tho rengs su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas be+ezur+ya snang ba'i zhing du gshegs so/ /bco lnga/ bsodanamasasachog grub grags bzang pa'i rnam thar7dor bsdus/glegs bam las/ rtsod dus dgu yi mtha' ma la/ /bsod nams mchogagi mtshan ldan pa/ /bstan pa'i me ro gso bar byed/ /ces pa ltar/ bsod nams mchog grub grags bzang ni/ rab byung bdukā ༵'i

sa yos (1299)lor shab dge ldings kyi sa'i char zhur gyi rigs su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gcig bzhes pa sa glang la mkhan chen grub pa shes rab dang / slob dpon chos ldan skal ba bzang po sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i spyan sngar rab tu byung / mtshan bsod nams mchog grub grags bzang zhes gsol/ dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa bya lo la mkhan po de nyid dang / dad pa'i dge 'dun nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/ mkhan chen gong ma gnyis nas bka' gdams kyi chos rnams gsan/ gzhan yang dka' bcu pa dar bzang dang / thub chen bsod blo ba/ snar thang pa rje shes rab seng ge/ rje tsong kha pa chen po/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhas spub chos rje/ spyan snga nyer gnyis rin po che/ gtsang pa blo bzang pa sogs cimakhasaspub kyi bla ma mang du bsten nas/ mdo rgyud kun la ma mkhyen pa med par nang byan tshud/ sa khyi nas chu glang bar lo bcu drug ring gdan sa bskyangs/ de nas dbus su byon de dpal phag mo spub pa'i chos sgo'i go sar bzhugs/ gong ma phag spu'i bla ma mdzad/ chos rje nam mkha' blo gros dang / chos rje don klub dpal/ chos rje lo chen/ chos rje 'dul ba pa/ chos rje dge 'phel sogs mkhas thub kyi slob ma mang po 'dus/bstan bcos kyi rtsom pa'ang mang du mdzad/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga bzhes pa rab byung brgyad pa'i chu spre (1452)lor phag spu'i gdan sa rangasdu sku mya ngan las 'das/ /

bcu drug mkhan chen grags don pa'i rnam tharasador bsdus/mkhan chen grags don ni rab byung drug pa'i me sbrul (1277)lor gan rtsar sku 'khrungs/ gdung ni gro la tsho bzhi yod pa'i 'brog tsho yin/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung ste sku shin tu btsun par gyur/ mkhan chenaspib pa shes rab la bka' gdams kyi chos skor rdzogs par gsan/(gdan sa gong ma khri gzhol mdzad nas 'di khri la ma phebs bar gdamyo sa lo bzhi stong )rab byung bdun pa'i sa rta (1452)lor gdan sa'i khrir phebs/ lo 2༷ring du gdan sa bskyangs te dgung lo go gcig bzhes pa me phag (1467)lor sku mya ngan las 'das/ 'phags pa'i kā/sdu ༵spya/ shā/ zlo/ zhig/ gi sprul par grags shing mkhas grub kyi slob bcu bdun/ mkhan chen bzod pa dpal grubaspyi rnam tharasador bsdus/mkhan chen bzod pa dpal grub ni rab byung bdun pa'i lcags sbrul (14༷1)lor chu sgo gzhung du sku 'khrungs/ gdung rus gro yin/mkhan chen thub pa shes rab nas rab byung bzhes/ / mkhas spub dge legs dpal bzang dang / rje shes rab seng ge/ thams cad gordiṭ+wāṃ pa

dge 'dun grub pa sogs mkhas thub mang po yongs 'dzin du bzhes nas sde snod la shin tu mkhas par gyur/ snar thang du mtshan nyid kyi bshad nyan yang mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu re brgyad bzhes pa rab byung brgyad pa'i sa byi (1468)lor gdan sa'i khrir phebs/ gdan sa lo gsum bskyangs te dgung lo 7༷bzhes pa/ rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags stag (147༷)lor sku mya ngan las 'das/ /bco brgyad/ 'gākā kātrīkā r+shatrīlab rākā ba/ zang po'i 'dul 'dzin dpal ldan bzang po ni rab byung bdun pa'i chu rta (14༷2)lor rta nag mdar sku 'khrungs/ mkhan chen spub pa shes rab las rab byung bzhes shing bka' gdams kyi gdam pa yang mang du gsan/ chen po lo myu salhashrī las sgra dang / snyan dngags/ mngon brjod/ skar rtsis sogs tha snyad kyi gtsug lag rnams bslabs/ dge 'dun grub las sde snod kyi chos mang du gsan/ rje shes rab seng ge las dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel sogs gsang sngags kyi skor mang dugasan/ gzhan yang mkhas grub chos rje la sogs pa'i bla ma mang du bsten nas lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan la mnga' brnyes/'dis snar thang nyid la brten cing gdan sa gong 'og gnyis su'ang chos gasdi~X mdzad de dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel gyi 'chad nyan

btsugs/ tshogagapas rtsa rgyud nar mar zhal 'don mdzad/ mkhan chen bzod pa dpal thub gshegs nas snar thang gi gdan sar gdan 'dren byung ba na/ phebs 'dun cher med na'ang mnal lam du mkhas pa mi nagagi rnam pa can zhig gis spos phor 'khyer byung ba mis pas/ chos srung gis gdan 'dren yin par dgongs nas rgyud kyi 'chad nyan rog tsho tshos mdzad la phog ste dgung lo re dgu bzhes pa/ lcags stag lor gdan sa'i khrir phebs/ lo gsum gyi bar du 'azin las bskyangs na dgung lo 72bzhes pa/ rab byung brgyad pa'i chu sbrul (1472)lor 'bri mtshams su sku sbya ngan las 'das/ /bcu dgu/ makā swā zi kātrīrākās/ tshan gyi mkhan chen shes rab rgyul mtshan ni rab byung bdun pa'i lcags glang (1421)lor shab stag la dang nye ba'i grong smo khar zhes par sku 'khrungs/ gdung rus dkar yin/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung /btsun chung gi dus nas bugs rab che zhing sgo gsum bag dang ldan pa zhigayod pas/ 'di snar thang gi mkhan po 'ong zhes kun gyis gleng ba byung / de nas thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun thub kyi zhabs la gtugasanas sde snod 'dzin pa chen por gyur te rtsed thang du po ti bco brgyad kyi grwa skor mdzad/ mthil du byon te chos rje bsod nams mchog grub pa dang mjal/ chos rje byams pa gling pa las sgra bslabs/ swā snyir

dga' ldan du byon te rgyud chen sbyin pa dpal las gsang 'dus kyi rgyud 'grel rdzogs par gsan/ de nas slar gtsang du byon te snar thang du mtshan nyid kyi bshad nyan thogs shig mdzad/ de nas tshe 'di la mthong lam thob pa zhig byed gsungs/ bshad nyan bzhag ste byang chub chen po'i dben gnas dang / rkang bzhi phu'i dben gnas sogs su thugs dam gtso bor mdzad/ de nas nye gnas chen pos snar thang gi mkhan por gdan drangs kyang phebs dka' bar byung ba la/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi bka' lung nan gyis phebs pa bzlog ma nus par dgung lo 52bzhes pa/ chu sgrul (1472)lor gdan sa'i khrir phebs lo bcu bzhi'i bar du gdan sa bskyangs/ de nas zur bzhugs mdzad de dbe+en pa'i gnas su thugs dam du bzhugs pa las sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus tshod sogs kyi yig cha kha gsal ma rnyed do/ /nyi shu/ mkhan tshen grags pa shesarab kyi rnam thararmodor bsdus/mkhan chen grags pa shes rab phyi ma ni rab byung bdun pa'i shing 'brug (1424)lor snar thang du sku 'khrungs/ gdung rus gnyan yin/mkhan chen grags pa don thub nas rab byung bzhes/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun thub dang / rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal ba/ mkhas pa dpal ldan chos skyong sogs bla zur du bsten cing sde snod kyi yon tan yonga~X su rdzogs par gsan/ mngon mtshan chung la nga rgyal dang / zhal

pho mi mdzad cing snar thang khron sbyag grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan yang thogs shig mdzad/ de nas mkhan chen shes rab rgyal mtshan pa zur bzhugs mdzad rjes dgung lo 62bzhes pa/ rab byung brgyad pa'i me rta (14ra6)lor gdan sa'i khrir phebs/ rnam par dkar ba'i 'azin las kyi sgo nas 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus tshod kyi yig cha ni ma rnyed do/ gdan rabs nyi shu pa 'di'i rjes tsam nas lo ngo 16༷lhag gi ring chos sde 'di nyid rim gyes nyams rgyad du song nas ha lam 'chal pa dang / ser khyim par gyur skad dang / de rjes paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dgung grangs brgyad cu lhag tsam la phebs dus rgyal ba lnga pa chen po dang / gu thi bstan 'dzin chos rgyal/ sde srid bsod nams rab brtan bcas kyis snar thang khulade bkra shis lhun po'i chos bzhis su phul ba nas chos sde 'di yang bkra shis lhan po'i khongs su chod cing / de nas paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes dgung lo drug cu lhag tsam bzhes skabs snar thang chos sder dag ther mdzad nas btsad dgon du bsgyur cing dge 'dun zhal grangs 2༷༷tsam dang chos phogs gtan 'khel mdzad/ dus de nas ṭāshādī /ṭā ༵sdo /gi /mkhan po yang bkra shis lhun po nas gtong ba'i srol 45

gsumapa/ bku' bstanapar skrun gyi byudz+wab/gcig bka' 'gyur3na po che par brko ji rtor byas tshul/rgyal dbang sku phreng drug pa blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshosastson gyi thugs bskyed rmad po che'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i par gzhi gsar bzhengs skor gyi bka' khyab mdzad pa las/sherasnyogs gtso bor gyur pa'i po ti 2ṭ+wāṃtsam 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi bgo skal du thon/ 'on kyang las yun lo 7tsam 'gor ba dang / bzo bo dang 'bangs rnams kyang ngal dub du ma myangs shing / gan mdzod chen po'i yo byad kyang ha cang 'dzad ches pa sogs kyis mthar ma phyin par 'phro can du lus pa dang / rjes su bod rje lha bzang khang dang / stag rtse tha'i ji/ rda ching la sogs pas 'asbo mthud kyang mtha' ma 'khyong ngo / /gnyis/ mi'i dbang por phyirang gisathun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i skor/yodang po chab srid thog gong ma'i sku tshab bod du ma phebs pa'i snga

'byoragyi dmag dpon so sor nga lum sbyar gsum sogs kyis mi bden bden tshul dang / dngos pos bslu brid byas nas rkun rgyab rdzun skyor byas te/ kho pa tsho rgyal bu'i re ba chen po 'chang yod kyang mi'i dbang po dam pa'i bsam sbyor rnyog pa dang bral zhing zla ba ltar dkar ba'i ngang tshul de/ gnam bskos gong ma chen po'i ye shes kyi 'dren byed kyis ji bzhin gsal bar gzigs par brten nas/ bdag rkyen gzengs bstod dang bcas sku tshab a li am ban brgyud nas phebs pas/'jigarten rgan po'i gtam dpe ltar/ mis smon rang skyid 'dus byas kyi dga' bde kun gyi phul dang rtse mor son zhing / lhag par sku tshab brgyud nas bod yul dbus kyi bya ba mtha' dag shes par gyis shig ces pa'i bka' gnang gser gyi rtsibs stong sug par smin pa dang gcigaganyis pa bsam pa'i cha rkyen ni lang tsho'i me tog nyams pas skyo zhing /lhag par dkar nag gi las 'bras nam yang chud mi za bas/ sdig tsong du ma zhig sngar spyad zin par 'gyod pa dang / yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhal nas kyang dal 'byor la snying po len dgos pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi thob cing / rgyal ba'i lung la tshad ma'i yid ches rnyed pa bcas kyis snying stobs 'di 'dra zhig 'gog med du 'khrungs pa ste/ 'gro ba'i phan bde kun gyi 'byung gnas dam pa ni/ rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa kho na la rag lus shing / de yang bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel ba la rag lus pas/ de thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am phyi mor rtser pa ni rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che 'di nyid la bug kyang / da bar 'phukā k+ton

paragyi chos sbyin grub pa ni sus kyang ma byung 'dug pas da res bdag gis lus srog thad du bor dgos kyang bstan 'gro'i ched du rgyal ba'i sdo/ḍi ༵ gyuṭ+wāṃ /rin/ po che'i par gzhi gsar du bzhengs par bya snyam du gsum/ bar du 'galarkyen khyad du bsad nas snying stobs 'dzugs pa'ispor/skabs de'i bod kyi gnas tshul ni/ gang ci'i thad dka' ngal gyi gnas su yod pa ste mi ser rnams khral dang dmag gi mnar gcod tshad medasmyong ba dang / nye 'brel bltos bcas nas kyang bka' 'gyur par brkokhyas na sngon yang mi shis pa mang po byung bas gshol dgos pa dang /gal te brtsams kyang mi 'thub pa sogs kyi gleng brjod ji snyed byung yang go yul tsam du ma bzhag par bden rdzun mtha' dpyad cing / 'di'i rim 'gror rten gsum mchod pa dang / chos srung la 'azin bcol/bka' 'gyur rin po che gang mang bklags pa sogs la 'bad/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che 'di'i gsung par mthar phyin pa zhig byung na srog dang / longs spyod mnga' thang gang gtong dgos kyang phangs pa ṭāshā da/ do'/spyo/da pa cha shas tsam yang med pa'i snying stobs 'dzugs par 48

bzhi/ par brko'i bkod 'doms dang dngos po'i sta gon byas pa'i skor/las byed kyang gang byung min par snga phyir drin gyis bskyangs pa'i rang g.yog lhag bsam can bskos/ dngos po yang gser/ dngul/gos dar/ tha ma ga sogs lag tu yod tshad bskur/ ma zad shel dkar rang gi sger pa/ dgon sde/ gtso drag mtha' dag gi yang rkang 'gro lag 'donayong 'bab thams cad bsdus nas khu ba sha thim yong ba'i bkod 'doms mdzad/ nub gcig rmi lam du yang bud med gcig gis/rgyal srid dbang ba las kyi 'phen pa ste/ / thams cad chos la bskul zhing bde bas skyong / / de tsam rang dbang thob pa'i las byas te/ / da lta yid rab ma zhum spro ba soms/ / zhes pa'i cugs bcad kyang gleng bas thugs la dga' ba dang spro ba ches cher brtas/ skabs der dbus gtsang so sor rang rang gi chab 'bangs kyi rgya khyon dang bsnan pa'i par brko'i rig byed 'dzin pa 'di dang de tsam la mthun rkyen sbyar te gsar du slob par 'os pa rnams slob tu chug cig ji tsam na mngon par byang chub pa de'i tshe shel dkar rdzong du las byed kyi grwar 'jug par gyis shig cesathing yig tu mdzad nas ring por mi thogs par phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun nas par brko'i rig byed 'dzin pa stong phrag tu nye ba 'dus shing / par shing gi yong khungs ni mang yul skyid grong dang / /k+to'

nang / rong shar/ mkhar rta/ gting skyes/ phag ri/ lho brag lha khang bcas sa gnas bdun nas lu gas dang / 'chus rul sogs ma yin par legs pa'i yon tan tshang ba'i stag pang sha stag drangs so/ /lja/ dngos gagi'i las grwa 'go 'dzugs pa'i dus dang gnas phun sum tshogs pa'iskar/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags khyi (172༷)lo hor zla /tshes 24nyin rgyal phur 'dzoms pa'i 'grub spyor bzang por gnas phun sum tshogs pa shel dkar mi 'gyur rdo rje rdzong gi 'dab rol par khang bden bzhi chos 'khor khang du btsugs shing / nyin der dkon mchog rjes shāṭ+wāṃ /sa kādo/ da/nga / shis brjod kyang mdzad de thog ma'i rten 'brel drug bzo bo las byedatsā sna'iskor/'go pa jo rigs thu lo shor che dpon slob sku mched gnyis dang /rdzong dpon gnyis/ shel dkar du yod pa'i par pa/ shing bzo dbu mdzad tsha rong pa pha bu/ e dpon tshang / yig rgan dbu mdzad bstan 'dzinabag gro/ par pa dbu mdzad blo bzang kun thub/ dbu chung pa brgya~X na dang rta 'grin/ phun tshogs dar rgyas/ snye mo pad+ma tshe ring

sogs kun bsdoms na chig stong la nye ba dang / zhus dag pa shel dkar chos sde'i grwa pa gnyis bcas yin/ /bdun/ las ṭ+wāṃkāswātrīkāshā shāg/ bsam las grwa tshugs pa nas bzung las byed mi sna rnams kyis gzhan bskul la ma bltos par dga' zhing spro nyams che la dad brtson dang ldan zhing rnam g.yengs kyi dbang du skad cig kyang mi gtong ba dper na/khamasagaseng la 'gro skabs kyang shar mar 'gro ba ma gtogs lab gleng kyang mi byed/ lag rtsal mkhas shing mgyogs pa phal che bas kyang mdun du sha phran bu re bzhag nas za ba las dgong tshigs kyang dgong mo'i las mtshamasagashol nas za bar byed/ gsar slob 'ga' shas kyi tshul min la'angasnag lcag dang / 'gram lcag thal lcag ha gad/ spyo ba tsam las gnag chos su bkar ba'i rigs gtan nas med/ rang gi bgo babs la dad gus kyis hur brtson byed pa las/ phan tshun 'khon 'dzin dang / rtsod tshig phyogs lhung gi rnam 'gyur zur tsam yang med/bzo bo'i rig byed stong du nye ba dang / lag g.yog brgya skor gyi mi tshogs shin tu che yang rgyun nad can gyi rigs nyung shas las de byings la 'go nad kyi rigs gtan nas ma byung / / 51

brgyad/ bzo bo rnams la stonayo 'gyed pa'i skor/snga sor sku zeng drug pa'i skabs kyi bka' 'gyur par bzhengs kyi las grwa tshugs nas lo bdun song yang bzo bo rnams la ston mo zhu mkhan ngam ring chos sde dang / ru thog rgyal po gnyis las drag zhan sus kyang zhus med rung / da lam bkra shis lhan po rang nas kyang ston mo thengs gnyisadang / gzhan yang sa skya sogs chos sde khag dang / sde dpon che drag bcu phrag kha shas nas kyang ston mo 'bul mkhan ches mang ngo / /dgu/ bzo bornamasat+pa lagazesad+ku tshad gzhitsā 'dra ba'ispor/sngon dus par bzhengs kyi las grwar mi res zla rer par shing lnga nas drug bar mtho shos yin/ bzhi dang gsum ni 'bring / gnyis dang gcig phal che ba/ gcig ma tshar ba yod skad/ da res kyi par gzhi gsar bsko skabs yang rtse'i gras tsha rong pa pha bu dang / e dpon tshang phun tshogs dar rgyas/ snye mo pad+ma tshe ring sogs mi grangs lnga drug gis zla rer par shing bcu drug nas nyer gsum bar dang / 'bring gras kyis bcu nas bco lnga'i bar/ byings kyis lnga nas phyed bdun bar chag med dadī/2 gsum ni nyung mtha' yin no/ /

bcu/ lasaka'i yun tshada' tsam 'gor ba'ispor/rang re'i ljongs 'dir chos rgyal gong ma sus kyang ma thub pa'i bya ba chen po de nyid mi'i dbang po 'di nyid kyis lcags khyi lo zla ba 8tshes 26nas chu byi lo zla ba 1tshes 26bar gshol zla gcig dang bcas las spraṭ+wāṃ sna //kā /dang/ zla ba drug gi khongs su spub pa de ni shin tu ngo mtshar bcu gcig 'gro song gi skor/'gro song kun bsdoms na/ gshor 'bo khal nyag gi gro zhib btsags ma khal 464—5dang / snum khal 1ṭ+wāṃ4—1rasgron snag khal 61—1༷khyin 'degs khal 220—14—r+ṇabal lcags 〉'degs khal 5— ṭ+wāṃ—2lcags 'dzog 'degs khal 1ṭ+wāṃ—4—2sol ba khal 4ṭ+wāṃ99stag pang ngo grags 27426shog bu nyis sbyar dras chog bre kha 1ra291shog bu bzhi sbyar dras chog bre kha——— 4༷889'jam rnar wol khog srus legs che chung ci rigs ngo grangs 4༷ratsub rdar ngo grangs 97gegs sel sku rim la song ba nas khal 2༷72—5gong gsal de rnams rin gong yul thang la rtsis na skabs de'i dngul rdo tshad 12༷—25—6—9srang rer gshor khal 2༷re rtsis pa bsdoms nas khal 12༷512—16thob bo/ / 53

bcu gnyis/ bzo poramasat+pa lagayonaskor/gsung rab rin po che'i las grwar bzhugs mi mi grangs chig stong la nye ba yod pa nas 'go pa dang / shing bzo dbu mdzad/ yig ge'i dbu mdzad/ par pa dbu mdzad/ dbu chung pa rnams la bla phogs rtsam gshorakhal lnga/ chang nas khal gcig dang ze bcu/ sha chung khog gcigasbre tshwa phul phyed/ nyin gla/ gshor bcu bcas dang / byings la rtsam gshor khal lnga/ chang nas khal gcig dang bre bcu/ sha chung khog gcig sbretswa phul phyed/ nyin gla bre bzhi phul phyed bzhi bzhi cha re thob pa bcas bzo bo mi grangs chig stong la nye ba dang / g.yog mi grangs 1༷༷skor la logacig dang zla ba drug nang gla phogs 'gro cha bsdoms na gshor 'bo khal nyag gi bar zhib 27༷rtsing khal 49246 —12 — 1chang nas khal 12557—6— 22tshwakhal 4༷5 — 19— 2 — 4—1snum khal 112—2—4—1phyurab khal 6༷5—1—12—1dral chag khal 4ṭ+wāṃ — 15chu sdur khal 292 — 1༷rgyar ngo sprod sha chung khog 8822sha bzang ngan phyed 'khyer chung khog 22༷ —5 — 2bzang ja 'degasakhal 692 —9—r+ṇamar 'degs khal 2962 —ṭ+wāṃ —lha—2༷— 1sha skam rus 'dzogs 'degs khal 64ra — 16 —sna yon 'brur phab pa khal 9946༷—4—5—22 —1sha dod phogs phreng gla swāsnyi bcas sgrus khal 22285 — 17— 2 — 10 — 1gzan pa

'degs khal 1745snyi ba 'degs khal 1raṭ+wāṃ972 — 2bcas pa rnams kyi rin gong skabs de'i yul thang ltar rtsis pa khyon bsdoms dngul rdo tshad 275 — 22 — 7la srang rer gshor khal 2༷re rtsis khal 275674thob bo /bcu gsum/ mgyogs tshad dang spus tshad la gzhigs pa'i bya dga'iskor/mi'i dbang po de nyid kyis bzo bo rnams kyi las yag nyes kyi sru ris legs par phye nas 'phral dang yun du gzengs bstod dang /'gal spyod rnams la btang snyoms su mi 'jog par tshar bcad/ de yang thog mar par pa rnams la par shing mgyogs rim gyi mgyogs dar kha bshad lag bzhag tu sprad pas/ ang dang po'i gras la mdzod btags che legs dang / bal ṭam/ ang gnyis pa'i gras la bsod btags re dang bal ṭam/ ang gsum pa'i gras la bkras btags re dang bal ṭam phyed re/ ang bzhi pa'i gras la bkras btags re bcas las rgyun gyi zla re bzhin chag med kyi bya dga' sprod pa dang / par bsko'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo gegs med grub zin pa'i grol ston gyi dga' ston skabs/bzo bo rnams la ja chang sogs mkho dgu'i yo byad lhug par btang ba sogs kyi mdzad rjes ni rjes su yid rangs pa'i gnas so/ / 55

bcu bzhi/ bka' 'gyur gyi gsung par rnams snar thang chos sderar+sāltar phebs tshul/mi dbang rtogs brjod las byung ba ltar bkod na/ bde ldan zhing gi mgon po bshes gnyen mchog gi rnam par rol pa thams cad mkhyen pa mahā paṇ+ḍi ta bskal brgyar 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i gsol 'debs rten 'byung rgya chen po dang lhan cig tu gsung par rin po che yang 'bul bar mdzad ces byung ba ltar/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes la phul nas/ paṇa chen rin po che nas kyang bka' 'gyur pod brgya dang gnyis kyi gsung par bzhugs khri dang bcas pa snar thang gi par khang chen mor bzhugs su gsol te/ nyid kyis gtso bo mdzad nas/ dam pa gong ma'i phyag len dang mthun par/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas rgyud grwa'i dge ṅgi/ ṭ+wāṃ kā / ṭ+wāṃ/sa da/nga lhan cig rab gnas mdzad cing bkra shis pa'i me 'dir smras pa/ gang gi snying stobs zla ba'i ma ma las rab 'khrungs 'phrul par srid gsum snang gyed 'di/ /bsil ljongs skye rgya'i phan bde ma lus pa/ /'byung ba'i rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rtar grub/thubadabang zhal gyi zla dkyil dngos shar yang / /dam chos bdud rtsi'i 'od stong 'gyed pa las/ / gzhan pa'i 'azin las gud na med pas na/ / bde gshegs slar yang byon dang cis mi mtshungs/ /mi dbang kukā ñcā gtsug na rab mdzes pa'i/ /bsod nams tshogs kyi stobs ni mi

byedroṭ+wāṃ kāl/ lda// kābyeṭā k+ta ṭ+wāṃ kā ṭā kādī /drin/ gyis nyer 'tsho ba'i/ /gangs bco lja/ mi'i dbang pos bstan 'tshor par sgrunaspradzadazu'i mthunarkyen dang snyang stobs 'dzugs pa'iror/sngon chad kha ba'i ljongs 'dir bstan 'gyur rin po che par brko rgyu lta zhog bris rgyun yang shin tu dkon zhing / par skun mdzad rgyu ni sngon gyi chos rgyal dang / mkhas btsun grub pa sus kyang thugs yul du ma dgongs pa ni/ mi yi bdag po 'di'i skal bar dgongs par snang ngo /chos rgyal 'dis bu ston rin chen thub kyis zhu dag legs par mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams zha lu gser gyi lha khang du bzhugs par phyi mo mdzad de rang gi brnyed bkur snyan grags sogs tshe 'di'i nyi tshe'i dgongs pa tsam min par bstan 'gro'i phan bde kho nar dmigs nas srog dang longasasbyod gang la'ang phangagapa med par zang zing gi nor las dam pa'i nor gyi snying po blangs/ don med pa'i dngos po don ldan gyi phyogs su ༵/kā dī/ //sa sbyi/na gyi sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba'i snying stobs 'dzugs bcu drug par shing rnamasaspyiyongakhungs skor/par shing gi sbyin bdag gtso bo ni lho phyogs nor 'dzin gīd+ngha ba

'brug pas mdzad cing / de byings shel dkar/ rdzong skyid/ gnya' nang / mkhar rta/ rong shar/ gting skyes/ phag ri/ du rdzong / se rdzong / lha khang / dar ma/ mtsho sna/ dwags kong sogs nas 'bad brtson chen pos drangs shing de dag la shing lu dang / gas 'chus 'dzer rul/ 'khyogs sogs med pa'i stag pang ngo grangs 764༷༷zin/ /bcu bdun/ 'gro song gi skor/rnam par dkar ba'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'di dbu tshugs pa nasaspathar ma phyin gyi bar la/ 'go pa/ las byed/ bzo rigs dang bcas par zur gzos su/ 'dzugs sgang grol gsum the ba'i ston mo thengs lnga/ yon kun bsdoms pa dngul thur srang khri tsho bdun dang nyis stong brgyad brgya drug cu re gnyis dang zho lnga la skabs de'i yul thang ltar brtsis pa'i 'bru khal sa ya gcig dang bzhi 'bum lnga khri bdun stong nyis brgya lnga bcu tham pa song zhing / gzhan yang ser skya mchog dman bar bcas nas bar ston dang zhal 'debs kyi rim pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul n+nisdu rdzu ṭ+wāṃk+to r+sha trī/ṭā ṭ+wāṃdzo/ dab/sta/na 'gyur dkar chag tshangs pa'i dbyangs bco brgyad/ 'go pa dang las byedas sna'i skor/las ka'i spyi khyab do dam gyi mgo chings ni/ ngor dbe+en khang bla ma/ju swātās kho sho'u chi/ las tshab pa'i gras mi grangs 22par yig pa ye

nas dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin bag gro/ dbu mdzad mobar nor bu/dbu mdzad chos bstan 'dzin/ bris pa byings 145snye mo nas dbu mdzad blo bzang rnam rgyal/ dbu mdzad bkra shis phun tshogs/ dbu mdzad tshe ring bsam gtan/ bris pa byings 49zhu dag pa dge slong grags pa chos 'dzin sogs dge bshes 22par bskos pa phun tshogs gling nas dbu mdzad bde legs bkra shis/ dbu chung chos 'byor/byings 77e nas dbu mdzad blo bzang kun thub/ dbu chung pad+ma bstan 'dzin/ byings 226snye mo nas byings 176dbus gtsang dwags kong dang bcas pa'i rdzong gzhis khag nas bsdus pa'i byings par brkos pa 225shelakar shing bzo ba dbu mdzad blo bzang byings 2༷lcags bzo ba bstan 'dzin sogs mi grangs glu7khyon 'go pa gnyis tshud pa'i las ṭ+wāṃd/ mi/ grangs 952dang lag g.yog 'u lag pa mi grangs 114zin bcu dgu/ par babo dbu tshugs pa'i dus dang lasaskuna' tsam 'gor ba'iskor/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i bod lcags bya lo'i (1741)zla 2tshes 27nyin 'go brtsams (skabs der mi dbang dgung lo 52yin )nas bod chu khyi lo'i (1742)hor zla bcu pa'i tshes 25nyin mjug bsgril te lo gcig dang zla ba 7tsam gyi nang legs par grub pa'o/ /59

nyi shu/ thub pa'irmothod brgya'i thang par dang tsong kha brgyad cu'i thang par sogs par skrunasadzad pa'ispor/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me stag (1746)lor pho lha'i sras wang 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyis mdzad brgya rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi thang par grangs 21dang / tsong kha brgyad cu'i thang par ngo grangs 15gnas bcu'i thang par grangs 7bcas gsar bzhengs dang 'brel paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dgung lo 9pa'i skabs paṇa chen rin po cher phul/ (paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi rang rnam bris ma shog grangs 25yi rgyab shog la gsal )nyer gcig patā trītrī sbyo tāṭā // shād+ngha/ chos sder paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi rang rnam du 'khod pa ni/ bod kyi srid skyong mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas nas/ gsar du bsgrun pa'i bstan 'gyur rin po che pod 225yi gsung par dang de'i par phud pod 225phul bar snang thang chos sde'i 'du khang chen mor kha gso dgos rigs 'phral du grub par mdzad nas der gsung par rnams bzhugs su gsol te rgyud grwa'i dge 'dun 21gis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa rgyas par mdzad rjes/ rgyud grwa ba rnams dang lhan cigam /sa sde'i dge 'dun pa rnams nas kyang shis pa brjod pa'i me tog

'thor bar mdzad ces pa ltar ro/ /smras pa/ da res snar thang chos sde'i lo rgyus rtsom sgrig rob tsam byas yod kyang nga tshor phyi nang gi cha rkyen shin tu zhan pa dang / dpyad gzhi'i yin rigs dkon cing nyams myong chung ba dang / cha rgyus zhib pa'i rgan rabs dkon pa/ khyad par lha khang rnams kyi dus tshigs mi gsal ba dang / gdan rabs rnams kyi 'khrungs yul dang / yab yum sogs kyi gsal kha ma rnyed pa bcas kyi dbang gis ma 'dang ba'i gnas hāl/ du/ ma lhag yod pas rjes su kha skong dang dgongs 'char yod pa slar smras pa/ rtsom pa'i khur bzhes mkhas mang bgrang las 'das/ /nged cag de gral snyegs pa gad mo'i gnas/ /'on kyang rang 'khri'ibago skal rdo yin yang / /mur ba'i dpe ltar bsams nas 'di byas so/ / mgrin pa g.yas 'khyil dung gi khog pa nas/ /thon pa'i nga ro'i sgra yi rdzing bu'i nang / / yod rgu bdud rtsi'i bcud dang mi ldan yang / /spyod par 'os pa'i cha yang 'ga' re mchis/ / / /bkras dgon lo rgyus rtsom 'bri tshogs chung nas/61
